title: Copyrighting all the melodies to avoid accidental infringement | Damien Riehl | TEDxMinneapolis
summary: Lawyer and musician Damien Riehl argues that music is math with a finite number of melodies, and describes how he and programmer Noah Rubin generated every possible melody and released them under CC0 to avoid accidental infringement claims.
why: HN cites it as the stunt behind 'copyright every melody' in threads about music copyright, takedowns and AI authorship.
